headline: GOLD SURGES 3.8%, Silver to $77.80 on Wednesday as Iran Peace Talks Ease Hormuz Fear
snippet: Gold June futures hit $4,711.90 Wednesday morning and silver recovered to $77.80 after a three-session slide triggered by Trump's 'Project Freedom' Strait of Hormuz vessel-escort program. Improving US-Iran ceasefire conditions and a softer US dollar are driving the sharpest single-day reversal in precious metals since late April.

headline: G2 GOLDFIELDS Drills to 1 Kilometre at OKO: 84.5m at 3.0 g/t Au Amid C$3B Takeover
snippet: G2 Goldfields' deepest drill hole at OKO, Guyana returned 84.5m at 3.0 g/t Au from 915m depth, extending the deposit 140m further to a full kilometre where it remains open. Infill hole GDD270 also returned 20.8m at 9.6 g/t Au, adding resource ounces ahead of the pending C$3B acquisition by G Mining Ventures.

headline: GREENLAND APPROVES Critical Metals' 92.5% Control of Tanbreez; CRML Surges 24% on Rare Earth Bet
snippet: Greenland approved Critical Metals Corp.'s acquisition of project operator 60° North ApS, lifting CRML's effective stake in the Tanbreez deposit to 92.5%. The southern Greenland site hosts all eight key heavy rare earth elements — including dysprosium and terbium used in EV motors and defence systems — with pilot plant operations targeted for May 2026.

headline: KLDC HITS 1,670 g/t Au Streak in Ontario: 39.35 g/t Over 16.4m in 40m Step-Out at Mirado
snippet: Kirkland Lake Discoveries drilled 50.3m of continuous gold at Mirado, Ontario, returning 39.35 g/t Au over 16.4m in a 40m step-out hole, with an ultra-high-grade 0.38m interval at 1,670 g/t Au. Six additional holes are pending at the past-producing property 20 km southeast of Kirkland Lake.

headline: BONANZA AT LUCKY SHOT: Contango Silver Drills 294 g/t Au, Buys Lease to Extinguish 2% NSR Royalty
snippet: Contango Silver & Gold's underground drill at Lucky Shot, Alaska hit a newly discovered 'KM' cross-cutting vein at 60.22 g/t Au over 5.92m, including 1.16m at 294.77 g/t Au. The company simultaneously acquired the project's underlying lease and extinguished a 2% net smelter returns royalty for $16M, directly improving feasibility study economics.

headline: COPPER SLIDES Near $5.85 as Iran and US Trade Fire in the Gulf, Testing Fragile Truce
snippet: Copper futures retreated near $5.85/lb after fresh military exchanges in the Strait of Hormuz cast doubt on the US-Iran ceasefire, rattling base metals markets that had been recovering from March lows. Aluminium also sold off before partially recovering as investors assessed whether the truce could hold through a second week.

headline: AI DEMAND LOCKS IN URANIUM at $86/lb: Meta, Microsoft Sign Gigawatt-Scale Nuclear Deals
snippet: Uranium spot held at $86.45/lb near two-month highs as the American Nuclear Society flagged deepening supply concerns against accelerating demand. Meta has locked in up to 7.8 gigawatts of nuclear capacity for AI data centres, while Microsoft has signed agreements for 800 MW of dedicated nuclear power — reshaping the structural demand curve for the next decade.

headline: TRUMP'S 'PROJECT FREEDOM' Escorts Vessels Out of Hormuz; Oil Eases, Metals Recover
snippet: The Trump administration's 'Project Freedom' initiative — guiding non-combatant ships safely through the Strait of Hormuz conflict zone — entered a second day, easing Brent crude from a conflict peak near $115/bbl toward $104. The de-escalation reversed a sharp three-day precious metals selloff and improved sentiment across base metals heading into Wednesday.

headline: COPPER BULL CASE: US-Iran War Exposes 20-Year Supply Deficit, Analysts See Spike Despite Near-Term Fear
snippet: An Invezz analysis argues the US-Iran conflict, while triggering near-term demand fear, simultaneously exposes the fragility of a copper market built on two decades of underinvestment. Supply disruption risk from Hormuz-region smelters compounds a structural deficit forecast to deepen regardless of how the conflict resolves — a potentially powerful long-term catalyst for copper producers.
